skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — combine my clips into a movie with transitions and background music — and...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Movie Maker Free No Login".
- Users can upload video clips or images (up to 500MB each) and describe the movie they want to create.
- No registration or payment required; session and free credits are handled automatically.
- Supports quick editing, combining clips with transitions and background music, and exporting as high-quality 1080p MP4 (and other formats).
- Includes clear guidance, automatic API session/token management, and user-friendly error handling for uploads and exports.
